status.description: 状态变更：pin 置顶避免淘汰、unpin 取消置顶、archive 归档释放容量、restore 恢复归档条目。 Status transition: pin protects from eviction, unpin, archive frees capacity, restore an archived entry.

tools.description: Reads a file from the local filesystem. Supports text files (with line numbers) and images (PNG, JPG, GIF, WebP). Cannot read directories.
tools.name: Read

file_path.description: Absolute path to the file to read

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to read (default: 2000)

offset.description: Line number to start reading from (0-based, default: 0)

tools.description: Load one available Skill by identity when its instructions are needed.
tools.name: Skill

tools.description: Replace all blocking dependencies of a task. All IDs must belong to the current task list, and the update must remain acyclic.
tools.name: TaskBlockBy

block_by_ids.description: The complete list of task IDs that must finish before this task; pass an empty list to clear dependencies

id.description: The ID of the task whose dependencies will be replaced

tools.description: Create a task to track progress on complex multi-step work only (3+ steps, dependent changes, or parallel sub-agents). For simple one-step requests, execute directly. Requires an active task list (create one with TaskListCreate first), otherwise the call fails.
tools.name: TaskCreate

subject.description: A brief title for the task

tools.description: Retrieve a task by ID. Returns task details including subject, description, status, and dependencies.
tools.name: TaskGet

task_id.description: The ID of the task to retrieve

tools.description: Complete the current active task list after all tasks for the current user request are done. This stops future reminders for that completed list.
tools.name: TaskListComplete

tools.description: Create a task list for a complex multi-step request (3+ steps, multiple dependencies, or parallel sub-agent coordination). Tasks created afterwards auto-attach to this list.
tools.name: TaskListCreate

subject.description: Short title for this task list

summary.description: One-sentence summary of the user request this task list belongs to

tools.description: List all tasks and their status. Use only when the latest TaskUpdate(status) progress summary is insufficient to choose the next step, or when the user explicitly requests the full task list.
tools.name: TaskListGet

task_list_id.description: TaskData list ID to query; defaults to the current active list

tools.description: List current and historical task lists, optionally filtered by active, paused, or archived status. Use a returned ID with TaskListGet to inspect that list.
tools.name: TaskLists

status.description: Filter task lists by status: active, paused, or archived

tools.description: Stop a running or pending task. Marks the task as deleted and cancels any associated work.
tools.name: TaskStop

task_id.description: The ID of the task to stop

tools.description: Update a single field on a task. Use to track progress through the task lifecycle: mark a task in_progress before starting work on it and completed when finished. Each call changes exactly one field; valid fields and accepted values are documented on the parameters.
tools.name: TaskUpdate

key.description: Field to update. One of: status (pending / in_progress / completed / deleted — normal workflow is pending → in_progress → completed; use TaskStop to delete a task), subject (string), description (string), priority (low / medium / high). Use TaskBlockBy to replace task dependencies.

task_id.description: The ID of the task to update

task_list_id.description: The task list containing the task. Required when updating a task from a historical list; omit to use the current active list.

value.description: New value for the field (always a string)

tools.description: Search for available tools by name or functionality. Use this to discover tools that can help with specific tasks.
tools.name: ToolSearch

query.description: Search query - tool name or functionality keyword

tools.description: Fetches content from a URL via HTTP GET. Read-only. HTML pages are converted to Markdown; large content may be truncated. For GitHub URLs, prefer `gh` CLI.
tools.name: WebFetch

tools.description: Search the web for current information, documentation, or answers to questions. Returns titles, URLs, and snippets; follow up with WebFetch to read a full page.
tools.name: WebSearch

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 5, max 10)

tools.description: Writes a file to the local filesystem. For existing files, Read must be called first. Prefer Edit for modifications; use Write for new files or complete rewrites.
tools.name: Write

content.description: Full text content to write into the file. Required (use empty string for an empty file).

file_path.description: Absolute or workspace-relative path of the file to create or overwrite. Required.
